div.head: Quadr Arg 25
div.ab: Et pristino licet imperio rebellia cuncta subegerit et — quod uere magnum est — pace solidauerit, nullum mentis miseræ uirus inhorruit, sed fauore propriæ maiestatis et Deo gratæ coniugis admonitione multaque consiliorum ratione firmatus, dulci morum facultate super omnia meruit honorari.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 535 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Mathilde II († 1118), auch sonst als human und fromm gerühmt: fiscalisch bedrängte Geistliche 1105 reginam interuentricem flagitant, illa pietate mota; Eadmer ed. Rule p. 173. Vgl. u. S. 543<sup>m</sup>

Matilda II († 1118), praised elsewhere too as humane and pious: clergy hard pressed by the fisc 1105 reginam interuentricem flagitant, illa pietate mota; Eadmer ed. Rule p. 173. Cf. below p. 543<sup>m</sup>
